websiteHero.body: AI 训练计划、训练记录、肌肉恢复估算与饮食建议，在一个 App 里衔接起来

subtitle.zh: 也听你要的天数、时长和重点
subtitle.zh-Hant: 也聽你要的天數、時長和重點
subtitle.en: Also the days, length, and focus you want

en.body: The screen shows a suggested week you can read before you save it. You can set the days, the session length, and the focus. An AI suggestion is requested over a connection, and Masso asks you to review AI access on this device before continuing. Free AI tasks on this device are limited.
en.scenario: You tell AI Coach what you want to train. The card on the screen is one suggested plan, not a prescription or medical advice.
en.faq: Generating an AI plan is requested over a connection after you review AI access on this device. Free AI tasks on this device are limited.

zh.body: 画面里是一份可以先看再保存的建议周计划。你可以设定天数、单次时长和重点。AI 建议通过网络请求，并且要你先在这台设备上查看 AI 访问说明。这台设备上的免费 AI 次数有限。
zh.scenario: 你告诉 AI Coach 想怎么练。卡片上的是一份训练建议，不是处方，也不是医疗建议。
zh.faq: 生成 AI 计划会在你查看本机 AI 访问说明之后通过网络请求。这台设备上的免费 AI 次数有限。

en.body: The colors and the percentage estimate recovery from training you logged. The percentage is an estimate, not a body scan and not a medical measurement.
en.scenario: After you log the work, the muscle view shows which areas that estimate still treats as recovering.
en.faq: Recovery estimates are based on training you logged, not a body scan or a medical measurement.

zh.body: 颜色和百分比是根据你记下的训练估算的。这个百分比是估算，不是身体扫描，也不是医学测量。
zh.scenario: 记下训练之后，肌群视图会标出这份估算里仍在恢复的部位。
zh.faq: 恢复状态由记下的训练估算，不是身体扫描，也不是医学测量。

mediaAnnotations.caption: This frame shows 49% and the label Recovering, keep it light. That figure is what this capture displays. It is not a medical measurement.
这张图上是 49%，并写着恢复中、建议轻练。这是这张截图里的数字，不是医学测量。

title.ja:
食事と睡眠を
まとめて管理

subtitle.ja: カロリー、栄養、睡眠時間
subtitle.es: Calorías, nutrientes y tiempo de sueño
subtitle.fr: Calories, nutriments et temps de sommeil
subtitle.it: Calorie, nutrienti e tempo di sonno
subtitle.pt-BR: Calorias, nutrientes e tempo de sono

en.body: Diet targets are starting estimates from body weight and common sports-nutrition guidance. They are not a measurement of what you need and not medical advice. The sleep screen compares deep sleep with your recent nights and calls that a personal reference, not a medical target. Connecting Apple Health starts on that screen.
en.scenario: You can look at meals and a night of sleep beside training. Neither is a diagnosis or a lab result.
en.faq: Do not read calories, nutrients, sleep time, or Sleep score in the pictures as lab results.

zh.body: 饮食目标是按体重和常见运动营养建议给出的起步估算。它不是你所需热量的测量，也不是医疗建议。睡眠页把深睡眠和你最近几晚比较，并写明这是个人参考，不是医疗目标。连接 Apple 健康从这一页开始。
zh.scenario: 训练旁边，你可以看到餐食和一晚睡眠。它们都不做诊断，也不是化验结果。
zh.faq: 不要把画面里的热量、营养、睡眠时长或睡眠得分读成化验结果。
